slug.description: The app's short name, unique among the apps installed on one app environment. It names the install, the tool documents it projects and the secrets that belong to it.

summary.description: One sentence on what the app does, shown in the Apps dialog and in the model's Space index.

type.description: The kind of value the argument takes.

secret.description: A secret argument (an API key, a token) is never written into a document. The person installing the app stores it on the app environment, where it is encrypted and paired with the install.

required.description: An install without this argument offers no tools until it is provided.

order.description: Where the argument sits in the install form, lowest first.

description.description: What the argument is for, shown beside its field.

choices.description: The allowed values, keyed by value with a label for each, when the argument is a choice.

arguments.description: The arguments an install of this app takes, keyed by argument name. Each entry says what the argument is, whether it is secret and whether it is required.

permissions.description: Grants the app's tools need beyond being called, as flags keyed by grant name, such as `publish`. A set of flags is a map because a document's attributes hold scalars and nested maps.

network.description: The hosts the app's code may reach, keyed by a label because map keys cannot contain dots: `{datalab: www.datalab.to}`. The sandbox lets the code reach exactly these hosts and nothing else, and an app that declares none runs without network. Shown to the person installing the app.

meter.description: Whether the server counts what the app consumes. `per-unit` means a server-wide install is metered per space and the Apps dialog shows what is used and what is left.

period.description: How often the count starts over.

callCap.description: The most units one call may consume. On a metered install the server reserves up to this many before the run and tells the tool its budget.

usage.description: How the app's consumption is counted and shown, so a server can offer the app on a shared key with a monthly allowance and tell people where they stand. The allowance itself is set on the server-wide install.

scope.description: `space` installs the app for the space the bundle is published in. `server` installs it for every space on the app environment, and is honored only in the server operator's space.

enabled.description: A disabled install keeps its arguments but offers no tools.

arguments.description: Values for the bundle's non-secret arguments, keyed by argument name.

install.description: Set when the app page is published into a space to be installed there, the copy form of an install. An app published as a library entry leaves it unset, and spaces install it through an app-install document instead.

description: The page of an app: the home page of an app, whose attributes declare its name, the arguments an install takes, the grants it needs, the hosts its code reaches and how its usage is counted, and whose body is the skill doc the model reads. Its `tools` folder holds one app-tool document per tool, each carrying its own code.
